bioconda.name: snp2cell
bioconda.summary: A package for finding enriched regulatory networks from GWAS and single cell data.
bioconda.description: A package for identifying gene regulation involved in specific traits and cell types. It combines three elements: (i) GWAS summary statistics, (ii) single cell data and (iii) a base gene regulatory network.

commands: if command -v pytest; then pytest tests; fi
